title: Multiple Choice - Sentence Completion
description: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

questions.text: Throwing oily food boxes into the paper recycling makes the entire batch __________, which prevents proper processing.
The eco-conscious cosmetics brand replaced plastic wrap with biodegradable cornstarch __________, which breaks down naturally.
Wind turbines and rooftop solar panels generate clean __________, which reduces our reliance on fossil fuels.
Before heading home from the workshop, technicians must __________ all electric heaters to prevent energy waste.
Adding dried banana skins and citrus __________ provides organic potassium to vegetable garden beds.
Instead of tossing uneaten dinner into the garbage bin, my roommate packs the __________ into a lunch container for work.
Rising ocean temperatures and shifting rainfall patterns are visible consequences of global __________.
Dense toxic smog from vehicle exhausts causes hazardous levels of __________, which triggers respiratory illnesses in cities.
Citizens who travel by subway and electric bus choose __________ over private cars, which decreases city traffic jams.
The hotel installed an __________ in each corridor, which automatically illuminates whenever motion is detected.
